data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 黄昏长椅上的硬币挑衅
data.description: 落日余晖洒满中庭木长椅，阿蕾克希亚双腿交叠，抛玩着指尖的一枚闪亮银币，微仰下巴带着得意又傲娇的浅笑看着坐在身旁的少年。
data.location: academy cobblestone courtyard garden beside flowering rosebushes
data.action: sitting on wooden bench with legs crossed in black stockings, flipping a silver coin with her thumb, smirking haughtily with a blush
data.lighting: warm radiant dusk glow washing over silver ponytail and sleek legs
data.mood: haughty tsundere charm, playful commanding arrogance, genuine fond warmth
data.promptProse: Sitting on an outdoor bench at sunset with crossed black-stockinged legs, Alexia flips a silver coin with a smug smirk.
data.animaCaption: Alexia playfully commanding Cid on the courtyard bench with a coin toss.
